    c = call(tmp_path).controller
    body = inspect.getsource(ControlledMedia._act)

    def hum(controller, ctx, step):
        ctx['actions'].append({'type': 'hum', 'epoch': controller.epoch, 'by': ctx['by'], 'word': step[1]})

    monkeypatch.setitem(ControlledMedia.STEPS, 'hum', hum)
    monkeypatch.setitem(ControlledMedia.ACTS, 'toy_hum', ('cut_sound', (('hum', 'la'), ('cut',)), True, False))
    c.cue_outstanding = True
    verdict, actions = c._act('cut_sound', 'toy_hum')
    assert verdict == 'do' and actions == [{'type': 'hum', 'epoch': c.epoch, 'by': 'test_a_toy_row_and_a_toy_verb_make_the_real_controller_act_without_a_line_of_the_gate', 'word': 'la'}]
    assert c.cue_outstanding is False, 'the step after the toy verb ran too: the cut'
    assert 'hum' not in body and 'toy' not in body, 'the body of _act names no row and no verb'
    assert inspect.getsource(ControlledMedia._act) == body

def test_the_cue_is_made_by_the_gate_and_nowhere_else(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    d = call(tmp_path)
    c = d.controller
    real = [a for a in c._cue('Налог платят раз в квартал.') if a['type'] == 'speak']
    assert real and c.authorized(real[0]), 'the real row makes a cue the plan waits for'
    # take the step out of the row: the same call of ``_cue`` makes no sound, so ``_cue`` is no way around the gate
    monkeypatch.setitem(ControlledMedia.ACTS, 'cue', ('speak', (), True, False))
    assert c._cue('Налог платят раз в квартал.') == []
    # and the dict of a cue stands only in the step, in the two shapes of one cue (the replay of the last portion, the plan's own)
    makers = []
    for module in controller_modules():
        for cls in [n for n in ast.parse(Path(module.__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')).body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef)]:
            for node in [n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)]:
                makers += [(module.__name__, node.name) for sub in ast.walk(node) if isinstance(sub, ast.Dict)
                           and any(isinstance(k, ast.Constant) and k.value == 'type' for k in sub.keys) and any(isinstance(v, ast.Constant) and v.value == 'speak' for v in sub.values)]
    assert makers == [('echo_sync.controlled_media', '_step_speak')] * 2, makers


def test_the_questions_before_a_sound_are_rows_of_the_gate(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    d = call(tmp_path)
    c = d.controller
    cue = [a for a in c._cue('Налог платят раз в квартал.') if a['type'] == 'speak'][0]
    assert c._act('speak', 'authorized', cue=cue) == ('do', []) and c.authorized(cue)
    stale = {**cue, 'epoch': cue['epoch'] - 1}
    assert c._act('speak', 'authorized', cue=stale) == ('stale', []) and not c.authorized(stale), 'a cue of another reply token is not the one'
    # the real rule of the row: a service phrase never sounds over the cue of the open question that is still playing (see the host test below); here nothing plays
    c._cancelled()
    assert c.may_sound('say', (None, None, None)) is True
    # tighten the row of the service phrase: the wire's question now answers no (a rule of the table, no edit of the caller)
    monkeypatch.setitem(ControlledMedia.STEPS, 'quiet', lambda controller, ctx, step: ctx.__setitem__('stop', 'park'))
    monkeypatch.setitem(ControlledMedia.ACTS, 'may_sound', ('speak', (('quiet',),), True, False))
    assert c.may_sound('say', (None, None, None)) is False


def test_a_service_phrase_is_held_while_a_cue_of_the_open_question_plays_and_goes_when_it_has_ended(tmp_path):
    """The one rule of the row ``may_sound`` (it decided nothing before: a stub that said yes): the wire asks it, once, before the first frame of a service phrase (``NativeMediaSocket._sound_gate``)."""
    c = call(tmp_path).controller
    assert c.question_id, 'precondition: a question is open'
    assert c.may_sound('say', (None, None, None)) is True, 'nothing plays: the phrase goes'
    cue = [a for a in c._cue('Налог платят раз в квартал.') if a['type'] == 'speak'][0]
    assert c._cue_playing(c.clock()) and c.cue_outstanding
    assert c._act('speak', 'may_sound', what='say', told=(None, None, None)) == ('park', []) and c.may_sound('say', (None, None, None)) is False, 'the cue plays: the phrase is held'
    assert c.authorized(cue), 'the cue itself is untouched by the rule'
    c._cancelled()
    assert c.may_sound('say', (None, None, None)) is True, 'the cue is cut: the phrase goes again'
    c.cue_outstanding = True
    c.question_id = None
    assert c.may_sound('say', (None, None, None)) is True, 'a cue of no open question is nobody to wait for'

def test_no_owner_of_another_family_stays_in_the_core():
    """controlled_media.py holds the constructor, the state accessor, the epochs, the table and the gate with its steps, and the shims through which the families ask it: nothing a family decides."""
    tree = ast.parse(Path(controlled_media.__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    cls = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == 'ControlledMedia')
    names = {n.name for n in cls.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)}
    core = {'__init__', 'state', '_act', '_new_epoch', '_cancelled', '_cue', 'authorized', 'held_cue', 'may_sound'}
    extra = {n for n in names if not n.startswith('_step_')} - core
    assert extra == set(), 'a method of a family stands in the core: %s' % sorted(extra)
    assert {n for n in names if n.startswith('_step_')} == {'_step_' + verb for verb in ControlledMedia.STEPS}, 'one function a verb of STEPS, no verb without its function'
    module_functions = [n.name for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)]
    assert module_functions == [], 'no module-level decision stays in the core: %s' % module_functions
    # nor an alias that binds a name of the module to what the class decides (``impersonal = ControlledMedia._impersonal`` was one)
    aliases = [ast.unparse(n) for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)) and any(isinstance(sub, ast.Attribute) and isinstance(sub.value, ast.Name) and sub.value.id == 'ControlledMedia' for sub in ast.walk(n))]
    assert aliases == [], 'a module-level name bound to an attribute of ControlledMedia stays in the core: %s' % aliases

def packed(path, parts):
    import zipfile
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as package:
        for name, data in parts:
            package.writestr(name, data)
    return path

"""The conversation memory proved END TO END (night 12-13.11): a call of three hours through the real controller with ``v6_memory=on``, ``conversation_ledger=memory``, ``topic_recap=on``
(tests/helpers_night_memory.py says what is real and what is scripted). What is checked is the request the text model was really sent, never the card on its own.

 1 a condition said at minute 5 is in the request at minute 40 and at minute 170, when the question hangs on it
 2 a correction is above the earlier fact: «не 500, а 700» - 700 is in the request, and 500 is told only as the line before its correction, under the heading that says the correction stands (U88, accepted 15.11)
 3 a slip of the recogniser is no fact: what a refined final replaced, or the next utterance took back, is not told as a fact
 4 who said it: the owner's words (the prompt said aloud) and the words of the room are not mixed
 5 speed: the card is not built on the hot path of a prompt, and the time of a request does not grow with the call
 6 bounds: v6_memory_chars / _lines / _step_min hold through the three hours; what goes first is a written rule
 7 the account of what was sent out: one journal line per request, how many characters and lines of memory went to the model (numbers, no words)
Cloud stand: nothing here is a measure of the laptop or the phone."""
import json
import re
import statistics

import pytest

import helpers_night_memory as M
from echo_sync import v6_memory as V


pytestmark = pytest.mark.usefixtures('no_lead')      # the lead is not the matter of these scenes (tests/conftest.py)


class Played:
    """What a played call left: everything a test reads, taken before the stand is closed."""

    def __init__(self, call, marks):
        self.requests = [request for n, _, request in call.requests if n == call.calls]
        self.when = [minute for n, minute, _ in call.requests if n == call.calls]
        self.cards = [row[1:] for row in call.cards if row[0] == call.calls]              # (minute, question, what the hook left after the policy, the history it left)
        self.hook_s = [row[1:] for row in call.hook_s if row[0] == call.calls]
        self.journal = [row for row in call.journal(last=True) if row.get('ev', '').startswith('memory_card')]
        self.said_back, self.cues, self.marks = list(call.said_back), call.cues(), dict(marks)
        self.ledger, self.began = call.c.convo, call.c.call_began
        self.profile = dict(call.profile)

    def request_for(self, question, after=0.0):
        return next(request for minute, request in zip(self.when, self.requests) if minute >= after - 1e-6 and M.asked(request).endswith(question))


def play(tmp_path, until, *, earlier=True, redial_at=None, **profile):
    call = M.Call(tmp_path, **profile)
    try:
        if earlier:
            M.earlier_call(call)
        if redial_at is None:
            marks = M.plant(call, until)
        else:
            marks = M.plant(call, redial_at)
            call.redial(20.0)                      # the line dropped, the phone dialled again 20 s later: the same conversation
            call.zero -= redial_at * 60.0 + 20.0   # the minutes of the stand go on
            call.go(39.5)
            marks[40.0] = call.minute()
            call.ask(M.Q_COND)
        return Played(call, marks)
    finally:
        call.close()

def stands_after_its_correction(memory, old, fix):
    """U88, the format the coordinator ACCEPTED (15.11): the memory card tells the numbers in spoken order and both of them, the old value and its correction as two lines, the correction AFTER the value it corrects,
    under the heading of the exact things that says so (``v6_memory.HEAD['exact']``): every line with the old value has a line with the new one below it, so the old one never stands alone."""
    lines = memory.split('\n')
    olds = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if old in line and fix not in line]
    fixes = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if fix in line]
    assert olds and fixes and max(olds) < max(fixes), (olds, fixes, memory[:600])      # two lines, the correction after
    assert 'после прежнего' in V.HEAD['exact'] and V.HEAD['exact'] in lines[:min(olds)], (V.HEAD['exact'], memory[:600])      # under the heading that says the correction stands after the old value

def test_5_nothing_is_rebuilt_on_the_hot_path(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """The request of a question only READS what was made ready when the words were written: no rebuild of the projection inside the hook, whatever the controller wrote before it
    (an answer that takes the place of the answer before it, a final the judge looked at twice)."""
    inside, calls = [], []
    real_apply, real_rebuild = V.Memory.apply, V.Projection._rebuild

    def apply(self, *a, **k):
        inside.append(1)
        try:
            return real_apply(self, *a, **k)
        finally:
            inside.pop()

    def rebuild(self, *a, **k):
        if inside:
            calls.append(len(self._rows))
        return real_rebuild(self, *a, **k)
    monkeypatch.setattr(V.Memory, 'apply', apply)
    monkeypatch.setattr(V.Projection, '_rebuild', rebuild)
    played = play(tmp_path, 62.0)

def sections(text):
    """{part: its lines} of a card."""
    out, name = {}, None
    heads = {head: part for part, head in V.HEAD.items()}
    for line in text.split('\n'):
        if line in heads:
            name = heads[line]
            out[name] = []
        elif line.strip() and name:
            out[name].append(line)
    return out


def minute_of(line):
    m = re.match(r'^- (?:(\d+) ч )?(\d+) мин', line)
    return int(m.group(1) or 0) * 60 + int(m.group(2))


def test_6_the_three_numbers_hold_in_every_request_of_the_three_hours(three_hours):
    chars, lines, step = (three_hours.profile[key] for key in ('v6_memory_chars', 'v6_memory_lines', 'v6_memory_step_min'))
    assert (chars, lines, step) == (V.START['chars'], V.START['lines'], V.START['step_min'])
    for minute, question, text, history in three_hours.cards:
        assert len(text) <= chars, (minute, len(text))
        parts = sections(text)
        assert len(parts.get('retrieved', ())) <= lines, (minute, parts.get('retrieved'))
        per_step = {}
        for line in parts.get('outline', ()):
            per_step[minute_of(line) // step] = per_step.get(minute_of(line) // step, 0) + 1
        assert all(n <= 2 for n in per_step.values()), (minute, per_step)
        assert history == [] or not text.startswith(V.HEAD['exchanges'])          # the card stands in place of the old block, never beside it
        assert minute < 30.0 or parts.get('outline'), minute                         # and half an hour into the call every request has the outline of it


@pytest.mark.parametrize('lines,step', [(0, 5), (2, 20), (4, 5), (20, 1)])
def test_6_what_goes_first_is_the_written_rule(three_hours, lines, step):
    """V.PARTS is the order of priority: a smaller budget takes parts away from the bottom of it and never from the middle; inside the budget no part above is shorter than with a bigger one."""
    shown = []
    for budget in (1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 8000, 20000):
        card = V.build_card(three_hours.ledger, M.Q_PRICE, budget=budget, lines=lines, step_min=step)
        assert card.chars == len(card.text) <= budget
        assert len(card.part('retrieved')) <= lines
        shown.append([name for name in V.PARTS if card.part(name)])
    assert all(set(a) <= set(b) for a, b in zip(shown, shown[1:])), shown
    order = [name for name in V.PARTS if name not in ('pinned', 'carry')]
    for names in shown:
        have = [name for name in order if name in names]
        if lines:
            assert have == order[:len(have)] or 'retrieved' not in names, names        # a part is there only with every part above it (retrieval may find nothing)

def real_tree():

    assert all(site.get('owner') for site in sites)                    # every place belongs to a judge

import re

ANSWER = 'Первая часть ответа про инерцию. Вторая часть ответа про силу. Третья часть ответа про массу.'


pytestmark = pytest.mark.usefixtures('no_lead')      # the lead is not the matter of these scenes (tests/conftest.py)


class Lines(logging.Handler):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.rows = []

    def emit(self, record):
        self.rows.append(record.getMessage())

    def verdict(self, tid):
        rows = [dict(re.findall(r'(\w+)=(\S+)', r)) for r in self.rows if r.startswith('echo-sync judge ') and ('tid=%s ' % tid) in r]
        return rows[-1] if rows else None


@pytest.fixture
def lines():
    log, handler, level = logging.getLogger('echo-sync'), Lines(), logging.getLogger('echo-sync').level
    log.addHandler(handler)
    log.setLevel(logging.INFO)
    yield handler
    log.removeHandler(handler)
    log.setLevel(level)


@pytest.fixture
def make(tmp_path):
    calls = []

    def build(**over):

        calls.append(call)
        call.say(QUESTION_IN_PLAY)
        call.pump(5.0)
        return call
    yield build
    for call in calls:
        call.close()

    tid = call.say(said)

def named(rig, ear, cloud=None, turn='u1', announced=1.0, speech=1.5):
    """The ear's text of a sum, the cloud's open turn that names the same sum, the ear's silence: the skeptic's rule (``ControlledMedia._ear_sum``): the ear alone cues no figure. Returns the end of the speech."""
    ended = speaks(rig, ear, turn=turn, announced=announced, speech=speech, partial=cloud or ear)

    return ended


def cut_since(rig, sent):
    """Did the wire tell the phone to drop what it holds of the voice (a cue may have been said to its end by then: the cut is still the order given)?"""
    return any(frame.get('type') == 'output_audio_buffer.clear' for _, _, frame in rig.w.frames[sent:])

# =====================================================================================================================================
# item 2 (idea B9): the early lookup is fed from the ear's text as well as the cloud's partial
# =====================================================================================================================================
# ``EarlyLookup`` (native_prefetch.py) prepares the existing public lookup for a question while it is still being said; the call's ``ear_lookup`` is off by default and stays so (the
# coordinator's switch: the tests below turn it on for themselves). It prepares and nothing else: no cue, no state of the call, no new check of privacy - ``prefetch_candidate`` asks the same of the ear's
# text as of the cloud's.
# Why it is off (see the report): the experiment of 29 Oct - 12 probes, none of the preparations adopted by the exact question of the final, usually two searches instead of one, no A/B that proved a gain;
# "the next step: the contract of the segments, the criterion of a useful first portion, only then repeat the early lookup". It was never switched on again. The cloud's partial lags the ear by about
# a second on the phone (1.06 s after the end of speech against 0.14 s) and shows a form only late, so the search used to start when the final was near.

import asyncio

from echo_sync.native_prefetch import EarlyLookup, question_key

KEY_RATE = 'Какая сейчас ключевая ставка Банка России'
EAR_RATE = 'какая сейчас ключевая ставка банка россии'
FINAL_RATE = 'Какая сейчас ключевая ставка Банка России?'
OTHER_RATE = 'Какая сейчас ставка налога на добавленную стоимость?'


def lookup_of(calls):
    async def fetch(question):
        calls.append(question)
        return [{'text': question}]
    return fetch


async def silent(*args, **kwargs):
    pass


class StubController:
    """What the feed asks of the controller: the cloud's open turn (``ledger.latest_user``) and the candidate of a text (``prefetch_candidate``)."""

    def __init__(self, text='', tid='u'):
        self.user = {'id': tid, 'text': text, 'final': False, 'valid': True}
        self.settings = None
        self.ledger = self
        self.asked = []

    def latest_user(self):
        return self.user

    @staticmethod
    def public_lookup_allowed(question, search=False):
        return True

    def prefetch_candidate(self, text=None):
        self.asked.append(text)
        return (self.user['id'], text) if text and self.user else None


def test_the_ears_text_starts_the_search_at_once_where_a_partial_waits_to_settle():
    async def go():
        calls = []
        early = EarlyLookup(lookup_of(calls), silent, enabled=True)
        early.observe('u', KEY_RATE, now=10)
        await early.tick(now=10.1)
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        assert calls == [], "the cloud's partial must be stable for the wait"
        early.observe_ear('v', KEY_RATE, now=10.2)
        await early.tick(now=10.2)
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        assert calls == [KEY_RATE], "the ear's text is a whole utterance: no wait"
        await early.close()
    asyncio.run(go())


def test_what_the_ear_prepared_is_adopted_by_the_same_question_of_the_final_and_by_no_other():
    async def go():
        calls, events = [], []

        async def trace(stage, **values):
            events.append((stage, values))
        early = EarlyLookup(lookup_of(calls), trace, enabled=True)
        early.observe_ear('u', EAR_RATE, now=0)
        await early.tick(now=0)
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        started = [values for stage, values in events if stage == 'speculation_started']
        assert len(started) == 1 and started[0]['source'] == 'ear' and started[0]['stable_ms'] == 0
        assert await early.resolve('u', FINAL_RATE) == [{'text': EAR_RATE}] and calls == [EAR_RATE], 'one request for the question and its final'
        assert any(stage == 'prefetch_adopted' for stage, _ in events)
        events.clear()
        other = EarlyLookup(lookup_of(calls), trace, enabled=True)
        other.observe_ear('w', EAR_RATE, now=0)
        await other.tick(now=0)
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        assert await other.resolve('w', OTHER_RATE) == [{'text': OTHER_RATE}] and len(calls) == 3
        assert not any(stage == 'prefetch_adopted' for stage, _ in events), 'what was prepared for another question is no source of this one'
        await early.close()
        await other.close()
    asyncio.run(go())


def test_the_ear_prepares_nothing_with_the_switch_off_or_for_a_turn_the_final_has_confirmed():
    async def go():
        calls = []
        off = EarlyLookup(lookup_of(calls), silent, enabled=False)
        off.observe_ear('u', KEY_RATE, now=0)
        await off.tick(now=1)
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        assert calls == []
        assert await off.resolve('u', KEY_RATE) and len(calls) == 1
        on = EarlyLookup(lookup_of(calls), silent, enabled=True)
        await on.resolve('v', KEY_RATE)
        on.observe_ear('v', KEY_RATE, now=0)
        await on.tick(now=1)
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        assert len(calls) == 2, 'one request for the final, none for a speculation after it'
        await off.close()
        await on.close()
    asyncio.run(go())


def test_a_turn_the_ear_prepared_for_keeps_the_two_requests_of_the_real_question():
    """The hard budget of a turn is two requests (test_native_prefetch, for a partial). A turn the ear prepared for has one more, for the preparation: the final and one restart of it are served even if

# =====================================================================================================================================
# the ear's hearing of a number: should a sum wait for the cloud's partial to name the last operand?
# =====================================================================================================================================
# The real NativeMediaSocket, ShadowEar and controller (the rig of H3/H4), on the phone's clock: after the end of speech the ear's text comes at 0.15 s, the cloud's words of the utterance are complete at
# 1.06 s, its final at 2.2 s. A cue of one figure lasts about 0.5 s. As delivered ``same_start`` left the last word of the partial open and a turn with no word yet open altogether, so the wrong figure was said
# to its end at 0.36 s, 1.9 s before the final could cut it. The price of the wait: the cue comes at 1.06 s instead of 0.36 s, against 2.2 s of the final. A missed sum costs the model's 2 s, the wrong one the call.

import helpers_s6_state as S
from test_h3_tempo import TICK, call                  # noqa: F401, E402 - call is the fixture
from test_h4_ear_first import final, speaks           # noqa: E402
from echo_sync.controlled_media import FIGURE_STILL_SECONDS     # noqa: E402

PARTIAL_AT, FINAL_AT = 1.06, 2.2
FIVE, THIRTY = 'Двадцать пять.', 'Тридцать.'
EAR_FIVE, CLOUD_FIVE = 'пять на пять', 'Пять на пять'


@pytest.fixture
def maths(call):
    def make(**profile):
        rig = call(fast_text='on', **profile)
        return rig
    return make


def on_the_phone(rig, ear, cloud, turn='u1'):
    """The ear's text, the cloud's words at their time (none when ``cloud`` is empty), up to the moment before the final. Returns when the speech ended."""
    ended = speaks(rig, ear, turn=turn, announced=1.0, speech=1.5)
    rig.pump(max(0.0, ended + PARTIAL_AT - rig.w.clock.t))
    if cloud:
        rig.w.feed(S.turn_delta(turn, cloud, 1))
    rig.pump(max(0.0, ended + FINAL_AT - rig.w.clock.t))
    return ended


# U43(a), commit 832d0778: two witnesses that differ get the answer with its operands named («Пять на тридцать — сто пятьдесят.»)
MISHEARD = [
    ('пять на пять', 'Пять на шесть', THIRTY),
    ('пять на тринадцать', 'Пять на тридцать', 'Пять на тридцать — сто пятьдесят.'),
    ('сорок восемь умножить на десять', 'Сорок восемь умножить на одиннадцать', 'Сорок восемь на одиннадцать — пятьсот двадцать восемь.'),
    ('сто разделить на четыре', 'Сто разделить на пять', 'Сто разделить на пять — двадцать.'),
    ('сколько будет семь умножить на восемь', 'Сколько будет семь умножить на девять', 'Семь на девять — шестьдесят три.'),
    # the ear lost the last word: a scale, the units of the number
    ('десять процентов от двухсот', 'Десять процентов от двухсот тысяч', '10% от 200000 — двадцать тысяч.'),
    ('двадцать плюс двадцать', 'Двадцать плюс двадцать два', 'Сорок два.'),
    ('сто разделить на два', 'Сто разделить на двадцать', 'Сто разделить на двадцать — пять.'),
]


@pytest.mark.parametrize('ear,cloud,spoken', MISHEARD, ids=lambda value: value.replace(' ', '_'))
def test_a_number_the_ear_misheard_never_reaches_the_earpiece(maths, ear, cloud, spoken):
    rig = maths()
    on_the_phone(rig, ear, cloud)
    assert rig.said() == [], 'the cloud names another sum: no figure of the ear goes out'
    final(rig, 'u1', cloud)
    if rig.said()[-1:] and rig.said()[-1].endswith('—'):
        # U43(a), commit 832d0778: the answer may be two portions (operands, figure): the listener says the first back, the second is cued, the whole of it is asserted
        said_back = rig.said()[-1].rstrip(' —')
        speaks(rig, said_back, turn='u2', announced=0.5, speech=1.0)
        final(rig, 'u2', said_back)
    assert ' '.join(rig.said()) == spoken, 'the only figure of this call is the one of the final'

def test_the_cloud_naming_the_same_sum_cues_it_before_the_final(maths):
    """What is left of the gain: at the cloud's partial, a second before its final."""
    rig = maths()

    rig.w.feed(S.turn_delta('u1', ' пять', 2))

def start(tmp_path, name):
    first, rest = U.ANSWERS[name]
    d = H.Dictation(tmp_path / name, first + rest, play_first=True)
    assert d.chunks[0] == first, d.chunks
    return d


def wait_cue(d, within=15.0, step=0.25):
    """Silence until the controller speaks on its own; the texts it said (the cue is played: it can be heard back and a tail confirmed), or None."""
    c, spent = d.controller, 0.0
    while spent < within:
        d.clock.advance(step)
        spent += step
        actions = c.tick(now=d.clock())
        spoken = [a for a in actions if a['type'] == 'speak']
        if spoken:
            for a in spoken:
                c.cue_started(a, voiced_seconds=1.0)
            d.play(actions, seconds=1.0)
            return [a['text'] for a in spoken]
    return None


def tail_of(d, k):
    return T.tail(d.chunks[0], k)

    try:

        assert PROBE.original is ORIGINAL and PROBE.threading is types and PROBE.data == {'k': 2}

def until(condition, timeout=3.0):
    end = time.monotonic() + timeout
    while time.monotonic() < end:
        if condition():
            return True
        time.sleep(0.002)
    return False


class Clock:
    def __init__(self):
        self.t = T0

    def __call__(self):

# What a road does when it is asked: ``say`` gives the text, ``fail`` raises, ``empty`` ends with no word, ``hang`` says nothing until the scene is over (or, for the first road, the job is cancelled).
def say(text=ANSWER):
    return lambda scene, cancelled: iter([text])


def fail(error):
    def behave(scene, cancelled):
        raise error
        yield
    return behave


def empty(scene, cancelled):
    return iter(())


def hang(scene, cancelled):
    while not scene.over.is_set() and not (cancelled is not None and cancelled.is_set()):
        time.sleep(0.003)
    return iter(())


class Scene:
    """The roads of a test: ``plan(road, *behaviors)`` is what each next ask of the road does (a road with no plan left hangs); ``asked`` is the order the roads were asked in."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.asked, self.plans, self.over, self.cancelled = [], {}, threading.Event(), []

    def plan(self, road, *behaviors):
        self.plans.setdefault(road, []).extend(behaviors)

    def _behave(self, road, cancelled):
        self.asked.append(road)
        plans = self.plans.get(road)
        return (plans.pop(0) if plans else hang)(self, cancelled)

    def primary(self, request, cancelled):
        self.cancelled.append(cancelled)
        yield from self._behave(PRIMARY, cancelled)

    def count(self, road):
        return self.asked.count(road)


def sse_of(scene):
    """The reserve's ``post``: what a road says goes as the lines of a chat stream."""
    import json

    def post(url, headers, body, timeout):
        road = ('GEMINI_API_KEY' if headers['Authorization'].endswith('k') else 'GROQ_API_KEY', body['model'])
        for piece in scene._behave(road, None):
            yield f'data: {json.dumps({"choices": [{"delta": {"content": piece}}]})}'
        yield 'data: [DONE]'
    return post


def channel(scene, *, cloud=True, primary=True):      # cloud: the cloud has its own answer to the question (the roads give up at ALL_DEAD_S and say no sentence); False: it has none (GIVE_UP_S and the honest sentence)
    clock = Clock()
    roads = Roads(scene.primary if primary else None, ReserveStream(KEYS, post=sse_of(scene), clock=clock), clock=clock)
    fast = FT.FastText(roads, instructions=lambda: 'POLICY', history=lambda: [], clock=clock, wake=lambda: None)
    if cloud:

    return fast, clock

def tick(fast, clock, upto, dt=0.1):
    """The loop ticks every ``dt`` virtual seconds to ``upto``; the events that came."""
    events = []
    while clock.t < upto - 1e-9:

        events += [dict(e, at=round(clock.t - T0, 1)) for e in fast.poll()]
        time.sleep(0.004)
    return events

    def behave(scene, cancelled):
        while clock.t < when and not scene.over.is_set() and not (cancelled is not None and cancelled.is_set()):
            time.sleep(0.002)
        return iter([text]) if clock.t >= when and not (cancelled is not None and cancelled.is_set()) else iter(())
    return behave

# --- a word nobody heard is no word: a twin that spoke and broke while the released job ended with none does not hold the failure for ever ------------------------------------------------

def hang_then_fail(clock, when, error):
    """A road that says nothing and ends in ``error`` at the virtual moment ``when`` (a ReadTimeout of a reserve road)."""
    def behave(scene, cancelled):
        while clock.t < when and not scene.over.is_set():
            time.sleep(0.002)
        raise error
        yield
    return behave


def word_and_break(scene, cancelled):
    yield 'Инерция '
    raise ReserveError('RemoteProtocolError')


def held_twin_scene(scene, clock):
    """The first road refuses at once; the second walker hangs to a timeout at 6 s; the last road (asked from 2 s on, when the others refused at once) says a word and breaks."""
    scene.plan(PRIMARY, fail(CR.FastTextError('http_429')))
    scene.plan(G120, hang_then_fail(clock, T0 + 6.0, ReserveError('ReadTimeout')))
    scene.plan(QWEN, word_and_break)
    for road in (GEM, G20):
        scene.plan(road, fail(ReserveError('http_429')))

def gated(gate, piece, then=None):
    """A road that waits for ``gate`` (an Event), says ``piece`` and then ends, or raises ``then``."""
    def behave(scene, cancelled):
        while not gate.is_set() and not scene.over.is_set():
            time.sleep(0.002)
        yield piece
        if then is not None:
            raise then
    return behave


def road_b_breaking(scene, gate):
    """B says its word at once and breaks when ``gate`` opens."""
    yield 'Слово дороги Б. '
    while not gate.is_set() and not scene.over.is_set():
        time.sleep(0.002)
    raise ReserveError('http_503')

def television_talking(seconds, gain_db=-6.0):
    """A TV next to the phone that never stops: SAPI phrases (real speech), 0.4 s apart, over room tone - the ear hears a new start after each."""
    names, talk, i = ('lookup_empty', 'synthesis', 'channel', 'other', 'answer'), [], 0
    scale = 10 ** (gain_db / 20)
    while len(talk) < ms(int(seconds * 1000)):
        talk += [v * scale for v in R.phrase(names[i % len(names)])] + [0.0] * ms(400)
        i += 1
    return appends(pcm(mix(noise(int(seconds * 1000), ROOM, seed=22), talk[:ms(int(seconds * 1000))])))

def slow_build(delay, made=None):
    """A stand-in for ``local_ear.make_onset``: the Silero detector takes ``delay`` s to build (in whatever thread calls it), like importing
    sherpa-onnx and loading a model from a slow disk; the energy rule is instant."""
    def build(engine, **options):
        if engine == 'silero':
            time.sleep(delay)
        if made is not None:
            made.append(engine)
        return SileroOnset(model=R.ScriptedModel()) if engine == 'silero' else SpeechOnset()
    return build


def slow_everywhere(monkeypatch, delay, made=None):
    """The slow build under BOTH names the host's code could reach it by (local_ear's, and the transport's own import of it), so that no
    way of building it on the event loop goes unnoticed."""
    build = slow_build(delay, made)
    monkeypatch.setattr(local_ear, 'make_onset', build)
    monkeypatch.setattr(native_media_socket, 'make_onset', build)

ticker, reader, lookup and synthesize closures, open_subscription), helper_bridge framing, portioner,
first_useful. What is faked, only at the external boundary: the clock (virtual-time loop), SAPI, the
lookup, the GPT-Live helper pipe and the phone's websocket. See tests/helpers_s6_fault.py.

Tests encode the requirement, not the present behaviour. A requirement that the code does not meet is an
``xfail(strict=True)`` with its defect id: DEF-FAULT-NN (listed in DEFECTS). When a fix lands, the strict
xfail turns into a failure, which is the signal to delete the marker.

import asyncio

# only) and the wire / host / TTS-provider part of DEF-FAULT-09 (failures logged with class and reason) were fixed by Wave 2 /
# Task 4 (spoken diagnostics): their markers are gone, their tests are ordinary tests now. DEF-FAULT-14 (a start of speech with no
# transcript, or a duplicate turn.created, held «the user is speaking» for good) was fixed by Wave 2 / Task B (HEARING_SECONDS), and
# DEF-FAULT-10 (one exception in a tick stopped every timer of the call) by the same task (the host ticker survives a failing tick).
# DEF-FAULT-03 (no watchdog on the answer: a silent cloud left the question silent for ever) was fixed by Wave 2 / Task D (ANSWER_WAIT_SECONDS).

# stay open and keep their other tests: the exception still escapes ControlledMedia.provider (DEF-FAULT-04, tests below that say

DEFECTS = {

    4: 'an exception inside first_useful/portioner/textutil helpers escapes ControlledMedia.provider and tears the call down',

    assert len(media) == 1
    host = {k.arg: ast.literal_eval(k.value) for k in media[0].keywords if isinstance(k.value, ast.Constant)}
    assert host == F.HOST_KWARGS
    assert [ast.unparse(k.value) for k in media[0].keywords if k.arg == 'settings'] == ['controller_settings(profile_settings)']      # ROOT-1: the host builds the controller's settings once, at construction
    wires = [n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.Call) and getattr(n.func, 'id', None) == 'NativeMediaSocket']
    assert len(wires) == 1
    assert [a.id for a in wires[0].args] == ['controller', 'emit', 'connect', 'lookup', 'synthesize']
    # the call's modes (voice, local mode) are the controller's: the host passes the wire only ``diagnostics``
    assert {k.arg for k in wires[0].keywords} == {'diagnostics'}

    ticks = [n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.AsyncFunctionDef) and n.name == 'tick']

    calls = [c for c in ast.walk(ticks[0]) if isinstance(c, ast.Call)]
    waits = [c for c in calls if ast.unparse(c.func) == 'waker.wait']      # one-timers: the tick is woken by events, 0.1 s (WAKE_TICK_S) is its ceiling, which the rig's sleep copies
    assert len(waits) == 1 and controlled_host.WAKE_TICK_S == 0.1

async def confirm_every_available_portion(rig):
    """The user repeats each portion they are given, until the system has nothing more to give.

    Returns the time of the last confirmation (the user has now done everything asked of them)."""
    last = rig.now()
    for _ in range(20):
        state = rig.controller.state() or {}
        if state.get('completed') or state.get('stream_waiting_next') or rig.current_portion() is None:
            break
        await rig.repeat_current()
        last = rig.now()
        await rig.advance(1.5)
    return last

def corrupt(event, path, value):
    """A deep copy of ``event`` with the field at ``path`` replaced; missing dict levels are created."""
    event = json.loads(json.dumps(event))
    node = event
    for key in path[:-1]:
        child = node.get(key)
        if not isinstance(child, dict):
            child = node[key] = {}
        node = child
    node[path[-1]] = value
    return event

def duplicate_plan():
    """Re-delivery plans. A user turn.created is only ever duplicated at once: after its own turn.done it is
    a different fault (see test_a_start_of_speech_without_a_transcript...), kept out of this property."""
    anywhere = st.sampled_from([None, 0, 1, 2, 3])
    at_once = st.sampled_from([None, 0])
    return st.tuples(at_once, anywhere, at_once, anywhere, anywhere, anywhere, anywhere, anywhere).map(list)


def collapse(texts):
    """Auto-repeats of one portion are consecutive duplicates; a double advance or a stale cue is not."""
    return [t for i, t in enumerate(texts) if i == 0 or t != texts[i - 1]]


async def play_dialogue(rig, plan):
    """Question, streamed answer, two repeats, «повтори», a new question. ``plan[i % 8]`` re-delivers event i
    after ``k`` further events (0 = right away at the same instant); None = delivered once."""
    index = 0
    pending = []                                      # (index after which it is re-delivered, event)

    async def fire(event):
        nonlocal index
        await rig.wire.provider(event)
        await rig.advance(0.05)
        delay = plan[index % len(plan)]
        if delay is not None:
            pending.append((index + delay, event))
        for item in sorted([p for p in pending if p[0] <= index], key=lambda p: p[0]):
            pending.remove(item)
            await rig.wire.provider(item[1])          # same instant: the clock is not moved by a duplicate
        index += 1

    for event in (F.created('u1', 'user', 'Что'), F.done('u1', 'user', F.DIRECT_QUESTION)):
        await fire(event)
    words = F.DIRECT_ANSWER.split(' ')
    for event in ([F.created('a1', 'assistant', words[0])] + [F.delta('a1', ' ' + w, n) for n, w in enumerate(words[1:], 1)]
                  + [F.done('a1', 'assistant', F.DIRECT_ANSWER)]):
        await fire(event)
    for n in range(2):
        await fire(F.done(f'ack{n}', 'user', rig.current_portion() or ''))
    await fire(F.done('rep', 'user', 'Повтори'))
    for event in (F.created('u2', 'user', 'Что'), F.done('u2', 'user', F.OTHER_DIRECT_QUESTION),
                  F.done('a2', 'assistant', F.OTHER_DIRECT_ANSWER)):
        await fire(event)
    await rig.advance(1)
    state = rig.controller.state()
    return collapse(rig.spoken()), (state['revision'], state['chunk_index'], state['answer'])


@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def clean_dialogue():
    return play_once([None] * 8)


def play_once(plan):
    async def body(rig):
        return await play_dialogue(rig, plan)
    mp = pytest.MonkeyPatch()
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            return run_wire(Path(tmp), mp, body)
    finally:
        mp.undo()


@settings(max_examples=10, derandomize=True, database=None, deadline=None, report_multiple_bugs=False,
          suppress_health_check=list(HealthCheck))
@given(plan=duplicate_plan())
def test_duplicated_and_late_redelivered_provider_events_change_nothing(plan):
    clean = clean_dialogue()
    assert clean[0], 'precondition: the clean dialogue is audible'
    noisy = play_once(plan)
    assert noisy == clean, f'duplicates {plan} changed what is spoken or the stored position'

def patch_at(monkeypatch, module, attr, value):
    """``setattr`` on the module; on ``controlled_media`` on every controller module that binds the name (the code that calls it lives in the cm_* mixins)."""
    if module is controlled_media:
        patch_controller(monkeypatch, attr, value)
    else:
        monkeypatch.setattr(module, attr, value)


def raising(*args, **kwargs):
    raise F.InjectedSegmentationFault('bug in a segmentation helper')


def raising_once(original):
    state = {'raised': False}

    def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
        if not state['raised']:
            state['raised'] = True
            raise F.InjectedSegmentationFault('transient bug in a segmentation helper')
        return original(*args, **kwargs)
    return wrapper

# 10. random fault schedules over a whole dialogue: the invariants that must hold WHATEVER fails
# ======================================================================================================

PAIRS = {'direct0': (F.DIRECT_QUESTION, F.DIRECT_ANSWER), 'direct1': (F.OTHER_DIRECT_QUESTION, F.OTHER_DIRECT_ANSWER),
         'lookup': (F.LOOKUP_QUESTION, F.LOOKUP_ANSWER)}

SCHEDULE_STEPS = st.one_of(
    st.tuples(st.just('ask'), st.sampled_from(sorted(PAIRS))),
    st.tuples(st.just('confirm'), st.none()),               # the user repeats the portion they wait for
    st.tuples(st.just('repeat_request'), st.none()),        # «повтори»
    st.tuples(st.just('stop'), st.none()),
    st.tuples(st.just('wait'), st.integers(1, 12)),
    st.tuples(st.just('synth'), st.sampled_from(['ok', 'raise', 'empty', 'hang', 'odd', ('slow', 5)])),
    st.tuples(st.just('lookup'), st.sampled_from(['ok', 'raise', 'hang', 'empty', ('slow', 6)])))


async def run_schedule(rig, schedule):
    """Execute the steps; returns [(time, answer text allowed to be spoken from then on)]."""
    allowed = []
    for kind, argument in schedule:
        try:
            if kind == 'ask':
                question, answer = PAIRS[argument]
                allowed.append((rig.now(), answer))
                await rig.ask(question)
                await rig.advance(0.3)
                await rig.answer(answer)
            elif kind == 'confirm':
                if rig.current_portion() is not None:
                    await rig.repeat_current()
            elif kind == 'repeat_request':
                await rig.hear('Повтори')
            elif kind == 'stop':
                allowed.append((rig.now(), ''))
                await rig.hear('Стоп')
            elif kind == 'wait':
                await rig.advance(argument)
            elif kind == 'synth':
                rig.synth_plan.steps = [argument]
            elif kind == 'lookup':
                rig.lookup_plan.steps = [argument]
        except Exception as error:
            raise AssertionError(f'step {kind}:{argument} raised {type(error).__name__}: {error}') from None
        await rig.advance(0.2)
    return allowed


def cue_belongs_to_the_live_question(rig, allowed):
    """Every spoken text is a portion of the live answer or novel text (a diagnostic); never a portion of an
    answer that was superseded (or stopped) when it started to play."""
    every_answer = [answer.lower() for _, answer in PAIRS.values()]
    for frame in rig.of_type('response.audio_transcript.delta'):
        live = [answer for t, answer in allowed if t < frame.t]
        text = frame.data['delta'].lower()
        in_live = bool(live) and text in live[-1].lower()
        if not in_live and any(text in answer for answer in every_answer):
            return f'{text!r} at +{frame.t - rig.t0:.1f}s belongs to an answer that was no longer the live one'
    return None


@settings(max_examples=12, derandomize=True, database=None, deadline=None, report_multiple_bugs=False,
          suppress_health_check=list(HealthCheck))
@given(schedule=st.lists(SCHEDULE_STEPS, min_size=2, max_size=8))
# the sequences that matter most are pinned, the rest is explored:
@example(schedule=[('synth', ('slow', 5)), ('ask', 'direct0'), ('ask', 'direct1'), ('wait', 8)])      # stale audio of a superseded cue
@example(schedule=[('lookup', ('slow', 6)), ('ask', 'lookup'), ('ask', 'direct1'), ('wait', 8)])      # stale lookup result
@example(schedule=[('synth', ('slow', 5)), ('ask', 'direct0'), ('stop', None), ('wait', 8)])          # «стоп» while a cue is being rendered
@example(schedule=[('synth', 'hang'), ('ask', 'direct0'), ('wait', 20), ('synth', 'ok'), ('repeat_request', None), ('wait', 5)])
def test_random_fault_schedules_never_corrupt_the_session_and_the_next_question_is_answered(schedule):
    """Faults in SAPI and lookup are switched on and off between steps. Independently of what is heard
    (DEF-FAULT-01/02/03 are about that), the engine must stay consistent and usable."""
    async def body(rig):
        allowed = await run_schedule(rig, schedule)
        revisions = []
        state = rig.controller.state() or {}
        if state:

            revisions.append(state['revision'])
        problem = cue_belongs_to_the_live_question(rig, allowed)

        rig.synth_plan.steps, rig.lookup_plan.steps = ['ok'], ['ok']        # the world heals
        t0 = rig.now()

* no empty or punctuation-only portion; word counts stay inside the configured bounds;
* the first portion is not an echo of the question; abbreviation expansion is consistent.

Oracles are independent of the code under test: the corpus (tests/helpers_s6_seg.py) DECLARES the pieces that
must stay whole, a boundary falling into one of them is a violation. The streaming checks run the real
``ControlledMedia`` built exactly like ``controlled_host.serve`` builds it; only the provider events are fed.

A test marked ``xfail(strict=True, reason="DEF-SEG-NN ...")`` is a REPORTED DEFECT: it fails today for the stated
reason and turns into XPASS (= error) the day the defect is fixed, so the mark must then be removed. Every other
test passes today and guards against regressions. Production code is not touched.

Defects:  DEF-SEG-01 range with a dash          02 time / ratio with a colon     03 fraction / «км/с» with a slash
          04 «100 °C»                            05 currency symbol after a number 06 century numeral + «век»
          07 «н. э.» / «тыс. человек»            08 full personal names           09 spelled-out numbers + unit
          10 units missing from the lexicon      11 initial = function word       12 stable_prefix + odd whitespace
          13 answer without terminal punctuation 14 abbreviation expansion, streaming
          15 first cue cut at an abbreviation period  16 first cue is an echo of the question
          17 streamed continuation breaks min_words   18 surname-first initials in a list
          19 first cue is a lone word of a phrase     20 first cue is a phrase the phone handles itself
          21 arithmetic expression / spaced ratio cut at the operator

def inner_cuts(item, parts, index, shift=0):
    """Positions inside portion ``index`` where a listener would accept a cut: not after a word that needs the next
    one, not next to a digit, not inside a declared piece. A portion with such a cut is NOT one indivisible unit."""
    words = parts[index].split()
    offset = shift + len(H.nospace(''.join(parts[:index])))
    flat = H.nospace(item.answer)
    spans = [span for _, atom in item.atoms for span in H.atom_spans(item.answer, atom)]
    free = []
    for t in range(len(words) - 1):
        left, right = words[t], words[t + 1]
        if not (any(c.isalnum() for c in left) and any(c.isalnum() for c in right)):
            continue    # a dash or a bracket on its own is not a word to cut around
        position = offset + len(H.nospace(' '.join(words[:t + 1])))
        if any(a < position < b for a, b in spans):
            continue
        # The end of a declared piece (an initial «И.» looks like the conjunction «и») is always a place to cut.
        ends_a_piece = any(position >= b and not any(c.isalnum() for c in flat[b:position]) for _, b in spans)
        last = (normalize(left).split() or [''])[-1]
        before = (normalize(words[t - 1]).split() or [''])[-1] if t else ''
        needs_next = last in KEEP_WITH_NEXT or (last in LOCUTION_TAILS and before in KEEP_WITH_NEXT)
        if not ends_a_piece and needs_next and left[-1:] not in SENTENCE_FINAL:
            continue
        if any(c.isdigit() for c in left + right):
            continue
        free.append(t)
    return free


def bound_problems(item, parts, cfg, *, shift=0, skip_first=False):
    """Breaches of the configured bounds that were AVOIDABLE: the engine's own contract is that only one
    indivisible unit may overrun max_words/max_syllables, and that a portion below min_words exists only when no
    neighbour could take it. ``skip_first``: the streamed first cue follows the first-cue gate's own rules."""
    problems = []
    if cfg['portion_mode'] not in ('syllables', 'meaning'):
        return problems
    for i, portion in enumerate(parts):
        if skip_first and i == 0:
            continue
        words, syl = H.product_words(portion), syllables(portion)
        if (words > cfg['max_words'] or syl > cfg['max_syllables']) and inner_cuts(item, parts, i, shift):
            problems.append((i, portion, f'{words} words / {syl} syllables, yet it can be cut'))
        # a meaning plan never joins across a sentence end: a short whole sentence is no breach of min_words there
        if (cfg['portion_mode'] == 'syllables' and words < cfg['min_words'] and len(parts) > 1
                and not (words == 1 and syl >= cfg['long_word_syllables'])):
            for j in (i - 1, i + 1):
                if 0 <= j < len(parts) and not (skip_first and j == 0):
                    merged = ' '.join((parts[j], portion) if j < i else (portion, parts[j]))
                    if H.product_words(merged) <= cfg['max_words'] and syllables(merged) <= cfg['max_syllables']:
                        problems.append((i, portion, f'{words} word(s) < min_words {cfg["min_words"]}; '
                                                     f'{parts[j]!r} could take it'))
                        break
    return problems

GRID_PREFIX = ('Это', 'было', 'давно', 'когда', 'мы', 'жили', 'тихо', 'вместе')
GRID_SUFFIX = ('и', 'потом', 'всё', 'стало', 'иначе')
GRID_ATOMS = {
    'range': ['1941–1945', '5–10', '2010–2020', '3–4'],
    'time': ['12:30', '9:45', '18:00', '10:15'],
    'ratio': ['3:1', '1:100 000', '16:9'],
    'fraction': ['3/4', '1/2', '2/3'],
    'slashunit': ['300 000 км/с', '60 км/ч', '5 м/с'],
    'degree': ['100 °C', '36,6 °C', '0 °C'],
    'currency': ['100 ₽', '1 500 ₽', '2,3 млн ₽', '500 ₽', '100 $'],
    'century': ['в XIX веке', 'XX век', 'в 18 веке', 'в XXI веке'],
    'abbr_era': ['до н. э.', 'н. э.'],
    'unit_abbr': ['70 тыс. человек', '5 тыс. рублей'],
    'name2': ['Исаак Ньютон', 'Нил Армстронг', 'Альберт Эйнштейн'],
    'name3': ['Александр Сергеевич Пушкин', 'Лев Николаевич Толстой', 'Юрий Алексеевич Гагарин'],
    'spelled': ['двадцать пять процентов', 'сто восемьдесят градусов', 'пятнадцать минут', 'три тысячи километров'],
    'unit_ext': ['250 миллилитров', '220 В', '2,5 гигабайта', '10 ватт', '3 суток', '20 вольт'],
    'expression': ['2 + 2 = 4', '3 : 1', '5 × 6 = 30', '10 − 4 = 6'],
}


def grid_texts(atom):
    for k in range(len(GRID_PREFIX)):
        for m in range(4):
            yield ' '.join(list(GRID_PREFIX[:k]) + [atom] + list(GRID_SUFFIX[:m])) + '.'


def cutting_cases(kinds, minimal, profiles=SYLLABLE):
    """``(cases, checked)``: every answer in which a boundary falls inside a declared piece of one of ``kinds``,
    shortest first. Looked at: the natural ``minimal`` sentences, the corpus, and a grid of contexts (0-7 words
    before the piece, 0-3 after) so that every cut position of every planner meets the piece."""
    cases, checked = [], 0
    jobs = [(text, [atom]) for text, atom in minimal]
    jobs += [(item.answer, item.atoms_of(*kinds)) for item in H.CORPUS if item.atoms_of(*kinds)]
    for kind in kinds:
        for atom in GRID_ATOMS.get(kind, ()):
            jobs += [(text, [atom]) for text in grid_texts(atom)]
    for text, atoms in jobs:
        for profile in profiles:
            checked += 1
            parts = P(text, H.PROFILES[profile])
            hit = H.cut_atoms(text, atoms, parts)
            if hit:
                cases.append((len(text.split()), profile != 'controlled', profile, text, hit, parts))
    cases.sort(key=lambda case: case[:4])
    return cases, checked


def assert_whole(kinds, minimal):
    cases, checked = cutting_cases(kinds, minimal)
    COUNTS['defect_cases_checked'] += checked
    seen, shortest = set(), []
    for case in cases:
        if (case[2], case[3]) not in seen:
            seen.add((case[2], case[3]))
            shortest.append(case)
    assert not cases, (f'{len(cases)} of {checked} answer/profile cases cut a piece. Shortest:\n  '
                       + '\n  '.join(f'[{c[2]}] {c[3]!r} -> {c[5]}' for c in shortest[:3]))

# F. the streaming continuation: stable_prefix
# =====================================================================================================

def commits(text, config, how='words', seed=1):
    """What ControlledMedia._source commits after the first cue: growing prefixes of ``text`` into stable_prefix."""
    pieces = H.slices(text, how, random.Random(seed))
    committed, current, out = '', '', []
    for piece in pieces:
        current += piece
        COUNTS['stable_prefix_calls'] += 1
        nxt = stable_prefix(current, config, committed=committed)
        assert nxt is not None
        if nxt != committed:
            out.append(nxt)
            committed = nxt
    return out


def cut_inside_a_word(text, prefix):
    return bool(prefix) and len(prefix) < len(text) and prefix[-1].isalnum() and text[len(prefix)].isalnum()


def commit_problems(text, config, how):
    problems, previous = [], ''
    for nxt in commits(text, config, how):
        if not text.lstrip().startswith(nxt) or not nxt.startswith(previous):
            problems.append(('not a growing prefix of the text', nxt))
        elif cut_inside_a_word(text.lstrip(), nxt):
            problems.append(('a word is cut', nxt))
        previous = nxt
    return problems

    assert not bad, show(bad)


def with_whitespace(text, nth, replacement):
    spaces = [m.start() for m in re.finditer(' ', text)]
    at = spaces[nth % len(spaces)]
    return text[:at] + replacement + text[at + 1:]

PORTION_CAP_WORDS = PRESETS['meaning']['max_words']

WALK_IDS = {item.id for item in PUNCTUATED[::4]}
RESLICED = random.Random(7).sample(PUNCTUATED, 16)
_RUNS = {}


def streamed(item, how='words', seed=0, config=None):
    key = (item.id, how, seed, json.dumps(config, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False))
    if key not in _RUNS:
        COUNTS['stream_runs'] += 1
        _RUNS[key] = H.stream(item.question, item.answer, how, seed=seed, settings=config,
                              walk=(item.id in WALK_IDS and how == 'words' and config is None))
    return _RUNS[key]


def spoken_part(item, chunks):
    """How the chunks relate to the answer: ('whole'|'head'|'tail_lost'|'head_and_tail_lost'|'modified', shift).
    'head' = only the head the system may elide («Инерция — это») is missing; shift = non-space chars dropped in front."""
    flat, got = H.nospace(item.answer), H.nospace(''.join(chunks))
    if got == flat:
        return 'whole', 0
    if flat.endswith(got):
        shift = len(flat) - len(got)
        return ('head' if H.nospace(item.elide).startswith(flat[:shift]) else 'modified'), shift
    if flat.startswith(got):
        return 'tail_lost', 0
    for shift in range(1, len(flat)):
        if flat[shift:].startswith(got):
            return ('head_and_tail_lost' if H.nospace(item.elide).startswith(flat[:shift]) else 'modified'), shift
    return 'modified', 0

def a_short_cue_could_say_more(answer, question, atoms=()):
    """WAVE 2 / L2: a first cue is 2-4 words (5 only to keep a unit whole). True when some prefix of 2-4 words says more than
    the question AND is a place where a cue may end: it does not end on a word that needs the next one and it tears none of
    the declared pieces. An opening that restates the question for longer than that has no short cue that says more."""
    words = answer.split()
    for k in range(2, min(4, len(words)) + 1):
        last = (normalize(words[k - 1]).split() or [''])[-1]
        if last in KEEP_WITH_NEXT and words[k - 1][-1:] not in SENTENCE_FINAL:
            continue
        prefix = ' '.join(words[:k])
        if H.cut_atoms(answer, list(atoms), [prefix, ' '.join(words[k:])]):
            continue
        if not H.echoes_question(prefix, question):
            return True
    return False

"""g25-silence (WAVE20): the kinds of silence and the words of help, and what each does. By the ear, fast, with no cloud: the real NativeMediaSocket, ShadowEar and controller on the
injected clock with the candidate's flags; only the ear's detector and recognizer, the cloud's events and the job's stream are scripted (the rig of test_h3_tempo). Each case says when the next
cue comes, what it says (from the right word) and that nothing is said twice. Nothing here is a measurement of a call."""

from test_h3_tempo import GRID, TICK, Rig

CANDIDATE = dict(fast_text='on', instant='on', material_pick='on', spare_helper='on', warm_start='on', open_overlap='on')
ASKED = 'Зачем нужен пассивный счёт'      # f84a05a9: «Что такое …» gets the lead «Пассивный счёт —» first (a rule of fast_text now, no key), which splits the first portion into two cues; this scene is about silence, so its question is one with no lead (tests/test_question_lead.py pins the lead)
ANSWER = 'Пассивный счёт учитывает источники образования имущества. Сальдо у него всегда кредитовое. Примеры: уставный капитал, кредиты и займы.'
P1, P2, P3 = 'Пассивный счёт учитывает источники образования имущества.', 'Сальдо у него всегда кредитовое.', 'Примеры: уставный капитал, кредиты и займы.'
REST = 'учитывает источники образования имущества.'
ACK_ALONE = EAR_BIND_SECONDS + 0.5      # a whole repeat the cloud never announced: the ear waits for its turn, then confirms alone
FAST = 1.0          # a command by the ear: EAR_COMMAND_SETTLE_SECONDS and the cue's way out, well under the cloud's final (up to 3.7 s behind on the phone)


pytestmark = pytest.mark.usefixtures('no_lead')      # the lead is not the matter of these scenes (tests/conftest.py)


@pytest.fixture
def call(monkeypatch):
    made = []

    def make(**profile):
        rig = Rig(monkeypatch, **{**CANDIDATE, **profile})
        made.append(rig)
        return rig
    yield make
    for rig in made:
        assert rig.w.violations == [], rig.w.violations
        rig.close()


def answered(rig):
    rig.asks('u1', ASKED, 0, ANSWER)
    assert rig.said() == [P1], 'precondition: the first portion was said'
    return rig.ended()


def after(rig, within):
    """Every cue said in the next ``within`` seconds, as (seconds from now, text)."""
    began, count = rig.w.clock.t, len(rig.cues())
    rig.pump(within)
    return [(round(c.t - began, 1), c.text) for c in rig.cues()[count:]]


def late_final(rig, uid, text, announce=0.6, final=3.0):
    """The cloud of the phone: its turn announced ``announce`` s after the onset, its final ``final`` s after the end of the speech. The ear's text comes 0.15 s after the end."""
    ear = rig.onset()
    rig.pump(announce)
    rig.w.feed(S.turn_created(uid, 'user', (text.split() or ['м'])[0]))
    rig.pump(0.2)
    ended = rig.offset()
    rig.pump(0.15)
    rig.worker.heard(ear, text)
    rig.pump(TICK)
    rig.pump(max(0.0, final - rig.w.clock.t + ended))
    rig.w.feed(S.turn_done(uid, 'user', text))
    return ended

# =====================================================================================================================================
# seeds: chains of silences and words of help, the invariants of all of them
# =====================================================================================================================================

STEPS = ('quiet', 'er', 'cough', 'start', 'pause', 'again', 'louder', 'blank', 'whole')
SAID = {'er': 'э-э', 'cough': 'кхм', 'again': 'ещё раз', 'louder': 'громче', 'blank': 'как там', 'pause': 'секунду'}
BOUND = {'er': TEMPO_FILLER_SECONDS, 'cough': TEMPO_FILLER_SECONDS, 'blank': TEMPO_FILLER_SECONDS, 'again': FAST, 'louder': FAST, 'start': TEMPO_START_SECONDS, 'pause': TEMPO_PAUSE_SECONDS,
         'whole': ACK_ALONE}


def chain(rig, seed, steps=6):
    """One call: the answer, then ``steps`` random kinds. Returns the faults found: (step, what)."""
    import random
    rnd, faults = random.Random(seed), []
    answered(rig)
    for n in range(steps):
        state = rig.c.state()
        portion = (state.get('chunks') or [None])[state.get('chunk_index', 0)] if not state.get('completed') else None
        if portion is None:
            break
        kind = rnd.choice(STEPS)
        rig.pump(rnd.choice((0.4, 0.8, 1.5)))
        if kind in ('start', 'whole') and rig.cues() and rig.w.clock.t < rig.ended() + ECHO_MIN_LAG_SECONDS:
            rig.pump(rig.ended() + ECHO_MIN_LAG_SECONDS - rig.w.clock.t)      # the portion's own words that soon after it may be its echo: the timer's wait stands then (H3)
        unjudged = rig.c.tempo_unjudged
        if kind in ('er', 'cough') and unjudged and rig.w.clock.t < unjudged[-1][0] + EAR_PILE_SECONDS:
            rig.pump(unjudged[-1][0] + EAR_PILE_SECONDS - rig.w.clock.t + GRID)      # the speech of a step before that no final judged (this rig has no cloud for it) and a cough within EAR_PILE_SECONDS of it are ONE pile of talk: the ear's text «сальдо у кхм» is words of the answer, a try, and the silence timer is re-armed from it (h28, ``_at_the_answer``), not helped at the cough: a cough that is its own utterance comes after the pile (seeds 5 and 28)
        count = len(rig.cues())
        if kind == 'quiet':
            rig.pump(rnd.choice((3.0, 10.0, 30.0)))
            continue
        if rig.c.auto_repeats >= rig.c.max_auto_repeats and kind in ('er', 'cough'):
            kind = 'blank'          # the cap stands for noise: a filler or a cough after it is no call for help (the owner's words are)
        judging = bool(rig.c.candidate and 'job' in rig.c.candidate)        # a job judges earlier speech (the ear's text with no final, H6 item 6): a cough waits for its verdict
        words = portion.rstrip('.').replace(':', '').replace(',', '').lower().split()
        text = SAID.get(kind) or (' '.join(words[:max(1, len(words) // 2)]) if kind == 'start' else ' '.join(words))
        ended = rig.says(text, speech=rnd.choice((0.3, 0.6, 1.2)))
        rig.pump(BOUND[kind] + GRID + TICK)
        new = rig.cues()[count:]
        judging = judging or bool(rig.c.candidate and 'job' in rig.c.candidate)      # or one began in the wait (the stand's job never answers; a real one does within ~1 s)
        if not new and kind == 'whole' and rig.c.state().get('completed'):
            pass                                                            # the last portion said: the answer is over
        elif not new and judging and kind in ('er', 'cough'):
            pass
        elif not new:
            faults.append((n, kind, 'no help'))
        elif new[0].t - ended > BOUND[kind] + GRID:
            faults.append((n, kind, 'late %.1f' % (new[0].t - ended)))
        elif kind == 'whole' and not (rig.c.state().get('completed') or new[0].text != portion):
            faults.append((n, kind, 'the portion again after it was said'))
        elif kind != 'whole' and not portion.endswith(new[0].text):         # the portion, or what is missing of a start said a moment ago
            faults.append((n, kind, 'other text: ' + new[0].text))
        times = [c.t for c in rig.cues()]
        if any(b - a < 0.3 for a, b in zip(times, times[1:])):
            faults.append((n, kind, 'two cues at once'))
    return faults

def test_chains_of_silence_and_help_hold_on_every_seed(call, seed):
    rig = call(max_auto_repeats=10)
    assert chain(rig, seed) == []

FLAGS = dict(fast_text='on', prompt_pace='on')

CHUNKS = ['Основные средства учитываются на счёте 01', 'по первоначальной стоимости.', 'Амортизация начисляется ежемесячно и отражается', 'на счёте 02.',

@pytest.fixture
def call(monkeypatch):

    def make(**profile):

        made.append(rig)

    yield make
    for rig in made:
        rig.close()


def at_portion(rig, index):
    """The answer asked and its portions repeated by the cloud's finals up to ``index``: that portion has been cued and waits."""
    rig.asks('u1', ASKED, 0, ANSWER)
    assert rig.c.state()['chunks'] == CHUNKS, 'precondition: the portions'
    for i in range(index):
        rig.pump(0.5)
        rig.w.feed(S.turn_done(f'r{i}', 'user', CHUNKS[i]))
        rig.pump(TICK * 3)
    assert rig.c.state()['chunk_index'] == index and rig.said()[-1] == CHUNKS[index], 'precondition: the portion waits'


def index(rig):
    return rig.c.state()['chunk_index']


def says(rig, text, within=3.0):
    """One utterance of the ear, then the first cue after it began (it may go out on the tick that took the text), or None."""
    count = len(rig.cues())
    rig.says(text, speech=1.0)
    began = rig.w.clock.t
    while rig.w.clock.t - began < within and len(rig.cues()) == count:
        rig.pump(TICK)

# ---- the sweep: every answer of the bank, the kinds at random places --------------------------------------------------------------------------
SWEEP_KINDS = ('stammer', 'twice', 'restart', 'false_start', 'cut', 'middle', 'plain')


def _sweep_case(rng, portion, kind):
    """``(said, the cue)`` of one stumble at a random place of ``portion``, or None where the kind does not fit. Portions with digits are left to the rows above (a number is cued whole)."""
    from echo_sync.ru_alignment import _known_word
    from echo_sync.textutil import norm_words
    tokens = portion.split()
    words = [norm_words(token) for token in tokens]
    if any(len(word) != 1 or word[0].isdigit() for word in words) or any(ch.isdigit() for ch in portion):
        return None
    words = [word[0] for word in words]
    n = len(words)
    if kind == 'middle':
        if n < 5:
            return None
        j = rng.randrange(1, n - 3)
        k = rng.randrange(j + 2, n - 1)
        said = words[j:k + 1]
    else:
        k = rng.randrange(0, n - 1)
        said = list(words[:k + 1])
        if kind == 'stammer':
            said[k] = f'{said[k][0]}-{said[k][0]}-{said[k]}'
        elif kind == 'twice':
            said.insert(k, said[k])
        elif kind == 'restart':
            said = said + said
        elif kind == 'false_start':
            if len(said[k]) < 5:
                return None
            said.insert(k, said[k][:3])
        elif kind == 'cut':
            nxt = words[k + 1]
            cut = nxt[:rng.randrange(3, len(nxt) - 3)] if len(nxt) >= 7 else ''
            if not cut or _known_word(cut):     # «письмен» of «письменного» is a word of its own: said, not cut
                return None
            said.append(cut)
    return ' '.join(said), ' '.join(tokens[k + 1:])

class Server:
    """The fake Responses socket. ``on(server, conn, number, request)`` answers one ``response.create`` (``number``: of the connection, from 0); the default warm-up answers ``response.completed`` with an id, a job ``Да.`` and
    ``response.completed`` with ``USAGE``. ``refuse``: the handshake is answered with that status."""

    def __init__(self, on=None, refuse=None):
        self.on, self.refuse = on, refuse
        self.connections, self.headers, self.requests, self.handshakes = [], [], [], 0
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.server = serve(self._handler, '127.0.0.1', 0, process_request=self._process)
        self.url = f'ws://127.0.0.1:{self.server.socket.getsockname()[1]}/backend-api/codex/responses'
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        self.thread.start()

    def _process(self, connection, request):
        with self.lock:
            self.handshakes += 1
            self.headers.append(dict(request.headers.raw_items()))
        if self.refuse:
            return connection.respond(self.refuse, 'no\n')
        return None

    def _handler(self, conn):
        with self.lock:
            number = len(self.connections)
            self.connections.append(conn)
        try:
            for message in conn:
                request = json.loads(message)
                with self.lock:
                    self.requests.append((number, request))
                if self.on is not None and self.on(self, conn, number, request) is not None:
                    continue
                answer(conn, request)
        except websockets.ConnectionClosed:
            pass

    def jobs(self):
        return [(n, r) for n, r in self.requests if r.get('generate') is not False]

    def close(self):
        self.server.shutdown()


def answer(conn, request, text='Да.'):
    if request.get('generate') is False:
        conn.send(json.dumps({'type': 'response.completed', 'response': {'id': 'resp_warm', 'usage': {'input_tokens': 800}}}))
        return
    conn.send(json.dumps({'type': 'response.created', 'response': {'id': 'resp_1'}}))
    conn.send(json.dumps({'type': 'codex.rate_limits', 'rate_limits': {'primary': {'used_percent': 12}}}))
    conn.send(json.dumps({'type': 'response.output_text.delta', 'delta': text}))
    conn.send(json.dumps({'type': 'response.completed', 'response': {'id': 'resp_1', 'usage': USAGE}}))

"""Wave 2 / Task 2: the controlled route is never stuck, never endless and always complete.

Three P1 defects of scripts/MULTITURN_FINDINGS.md (offline replays of the real controller):

G2  Playback died for good after 21-62 ACKs inside ONE answer. The 64-turn ledger (voice_turns.FramelessTurns) evicted the
    turn of the question that was still being answered, and NativeMediaSocket._can_play() needs that turn in the ledger,
    so every later cue stayed in ``pending_cue``. The same eviction could take the assistant turn that streams the answer.
G3  An answer whose final text does not end in «.!?…» lost its last portions (a single provider-final turn: all but the
    first one). The delegation transport must not call a segment ending in letters final, because a continuation segment
    may follow, and nothing ever finished the stream when none came.
G5  An unconfirmed portion was re-spoken in silence for ever (70 repeats in 300 s).

Everything here runs the real ControlledMedia / NativeMediaSocket built with the production keywords of
controlled_host.serve. Only the I/O is fake and time is an injected clock: nothing sleeps, no network, no TTS, no server.
"""

def created(tid, role, text):
    return {'type': 'turn.created', 'turn': {'id': tid, 'role': role, 'transcript': text}}


def delta(tid, text, n):
    return {'type': 'turn.delta', 'turn_id': tid, 'delta': text, 'start_ms': n * 40, 'end_ms': n * 40 + 39}


def done(tid, role, text):
    return {'type': 'turn.done', 'turn': {'id': tid, 'role': role, 'transcript': text}}


def words(text):

def squeeze(text):

class Clock:
    """Injectable time for ControlledMedia(clock=...) and NativeMediaSocket(clock=...)."""

    def __init__(self, now=100.0):
        self.now = now

    def __call__(self):
        return self.now


def host_controller(tmp_path, clock=None, **overrides):
    extra = {'clock': clock} if clock is not None else {}
    return ControlledMedia(tmp_path / 'controlled-state.sqlite3', session_id='native-probe-' + '0' * 32,

# --- the transport: NativeMediaSocket on fake I/O ---------------------------------------------------------------

class Wire:
    """``spoken`` is every text handed to the voice, in order: what the phone would hear."""

    def __init__(self, controller, clock=None):
        self.sent, self.spoken = [], []

        async def emit(frame):
            self.sent.append(frame)

        async def synthesize(text, end=None):
            self.spoken.append(text)
            return b'\0' * 960  # 20 ms of PCM: _speak has nothing to wait for

        self.socket = NativeMediaSocket(controller, emit, lambda: None, lambda _: None, synthesize, clock=clock)
        self.socket.ready = True

    async def feed(self, *events):
        for event in events:
            await self.socket.provider(event)

    async def settle(self):
        await asyncio.gather(*self.socket.tasks, return_exceptions=True)


def user_turn(tid, text):
    """What the wire carries for one spoken utterance: a partial turn, then its final."""
    return [created(tid, 'user', text[:3]), done(tid, 'user', text)]

def timed(kind, tid, role, text, start):

def test_ledger_eviction_spares_the_turns_its_owner_still_needs_and_stays_bounded():
    needed = {'q'}
    ledger = FramelessTurns(max_turns=4, keep=lambda: needed)
    ledger.apply(timed('turn.done', 'q', 'user', 'Вопрос', 0))
    for n in range(1, 40):
        ledger.apply(timed('turn.done', f't{n}', 'user', f'Реплика {n}', n * 1000))
    ids = [turn['id'] for turn in ledger.history()]
    assert ids == ['q', 't37', 't38', 't39']       # bounded; the 39 newer turns pushed out only finished history
    needed.clear()                                  # once nobody needs it, it is evictable like everything else
    ledger.apply(timed('turn.done', 't40', 'user', 'Реплика 40', 40000))
    assert [turn['id'] for turn in ledger.history()] == ['t37', 't38', 't39', 't40']

        await wire.settle()

        for k, portion in enumerate(chunks):

def test_the_turn_that_streams_the_active_answer_is_never_evicted(tmp_path):
    """More than a hundred other turns pass while ONE answer is still streaming: its later deltas must still arrive."""
    c = host_controller(tmp_path, Clock())
    for event in user_turn('u1', 'Как устроена погода'):
        c.provider(event)
    text = long_answer(12)
    pieces = words(text)
    c.provider(created('a1', 'assistant', pieces[0]))
    for n, piece in enumerate(pieces[1:18], 1):          # F1: stopped inside a sentence (the 20th word ends one: all of it is said)
        c.provider(delta('a1', piece, n))
    before = len(c.published.split())
    assert 0 < before < 20
    for n in range(70):                       # the user mumbles, the model chatters: 140 other turns
        for event in user_turn(f'm{n}', 'угу'):
            c.provider(event)
        c.provider(done(f'c{n}', 'assistant', 'Хорошо.'))
    for n, piece in enumerate(pieces[18:], 18):
        c.provider(delta('a1', piece, n))
    # The rest of the stream was published as it arrived (only the last portion and word are withheld while it
    # streams). Before the fix the turn was gone from the ledger, so every later delta was dropped on the floor.
    assert len(c.published.split()) >= len(pieces) - 10, 'the deltas after the other turns went by were lost'
    c.provider(done('a1', 'assistant', text))
    assert squeeze(' '.join(c.state()['chunks'])) == squeeze(text)
    assert len(c.ledger.history()) <= c.ledger.max_turns


# ===================================================================================================================
# The driver for G3 and G5: the host's 0.1 s tick on an injected clock, with a transport and a listener
# ===================================================================================================================

class Run:
    """The production-profile controller driven the way the host drives it, on an injected clock.

    ``at(seconds, event)`` schedules a provider event; ``until(seconds)`` advances time in the host's 0.1 s ticks, feeding
    events when they are due and calling ``tick`` after them. ``play`` is how long the transport takes to play a cue; it then
    reports the end of the playout the way NativeMediaSocket._speak does (None: never reports). ``ack_after`` makes the
    listener repeat every cue aloud that long after it was produced (None: the listener is silent).
    """
    ORIGIN = 100.0

    def __init__(self, tmp_path, *, play=None, ack_after=None, **overrides):
        self.clock = Clock(self.ORIGIN)
        self.c = host_controller(tmp_path, self.clock, **overrides)
        self.play, self.ack_after = play, ack_after
        self.cues = []        # (seconds since the start, text)
        self.agenda, self.step, self.order, self.acks = [], 0, 0, 0

    def _add(self, seconds, kind, payload):
        self.order += 1
        self.agenda.append((seconds, self.order, kind, payload))

    def at(self, seconds, *events):
        for event in events:
            self._add(seconds, 'event', event)

    def ask(self, question, at=0.0, tid='u1'):
        self.at(at, created(tid, 'user', question.split()[0]), done(tid, 'user', question))

    def whole(self, text, at, tid='a1'):
        """The assistant turn arrives in one piece."""
        self.at(at, created(tid, 'assistant', words(text)[0]), done(tid, 'assistant', text))

    def stream(self, text, start, end, tid='a1'):
        """The assistant turn streams word by word from ``start`` and ends at ``end``."""
        pieces = words(text)
        step = (end - start) / len(pieces)
        self.at(start, created(tid, 'assistant', pieces[0]))
        for n, piece in enumerate(pieces[1:], 1):
            self.at(round(start + n * step, 3), delta(tid, piece, n))
        self.at(end, done(tid, 'assistant', text))

    def until(self, seconds):
        last = int(round(seconds * 10))
        while self.step <= last:
            now = self.step / 10
            self.clock.now = self.ORIGIN + now
            self.c.mic_packet(4800, -70.0, now=self.clock.now)      # the phone's line: 0.1 s of a quiet room every host tick (a line with no packets holds every silent repeat)
            due = sorted(item for item in self.agenda if item[0] <= now + 1e-9)
            self.agenda = [item for item in self.agenda if item[0] > now + 1e-9]
            actions = []
            for _, _, kind, payload in due:
                if kind == 'event':
                    actions += self.c.provider(payload)
                else:
                    self.c.playback_done(payload, now=self.clock.now)
            actions += self.c.tick(now=self.clock.now)
            for action in actions:
                if action['type'] != 'speak':
                    continue
                self.cues.append((now, action['text']))
                if self.play is not None:
                    self._add(now + self.play, 'played', action)
                if self.ack_after is not None:
                    self.acks += 1
                    self._add(now + self.ack_after, 'event', done(f'ack{self.acks}', 'user', action['text']))
            self.step += 1

    @property
    def heard(self):
        return squeeze(' '.join(text for _, text in self.cues))

    @property
    def texts(self):
        return [text for _, text in self.cues]

    def state(self):
        return self.c.state()

def distinct_in_order(cues):
    """The portions in the order they were first spoken (a repeat of the same portion, in a row, is one)."""
    out = []
    for cue in cues:
        if not out or out[-1] != cue:
            out.append(cue)
    return out
